title: Certificate input
description: Input for the certificate templates. Data only; never code or expressions.

recipient_name.description: Name printed on the certificate. Normalised to NFC before render.

issued_on.description: ISO 8601 calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Formatting into EN/VI patterns happens at render time.

serial.description: Optional certificate serial. Rendered as-is; not a verification claim.

qr_url.description: Optional URL encoded in the QR element. Must be https in live mode.

doc_language.description: Language of fixed labels inside the document. Independent of the UI language.
